prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2019 – up to 500-word summary

Core pledge
- Stop Brexit: If elected with a majority, revoke Article 50; otherwise back a People’s Vote with the option to remain. Use a £50bn “Remain Bonus” to invest in services and reduce inequality.

Economy, work and public finances
- Invest £130bn in infrastructure (transport, energy, schools, hospitals, housing) and a £50bn Regional Rebalancing Programme plus a Just Transition Fund.
- Raise R&D to 3% of GDP; expand the British Business Bank and create a £5bn Green Investment Bank.
- Fair taxes: restore Corporation Tax to 20%; replace Business Rates with a Commercial Landowner Levy; crack down on avoidance (incl. tech giants).
- Introduce a wellbeing budget; ensure debt falls as a share of GDP; protect Bank of England independence.
- Skills Wallet: £10,000 for every adult for lifelong learning; reform apprenticeship levy.
- Workers’ rights: new “dependent contractor” status; flexible working from day one; higher minimum wage (+20%) for zero-hours at normal demand; new Worker Protection Authority; stronger employee voice on boards.

Education and childcare
- Free, high‑quality childcare from 9 months for working parents (35 hours, 48 weeks); extend to all 2–4 year‑olds; triple Early Years Pupil Premium; £1bn for Children’s Centres.
- Reverse school cuts; hire 20,000 teachers; clear repair backlogs; boost SEND funding.
- Scrap SATs and narrow “league tables”; replace Ofsted with broader inspections; protect arts.
- Further and higher education: +£1bn for FE; restore maintenance grants; stronger student mental health duties.

Climate, nature and transport
- Net zero by 2045; at least 80% of electricity from renewables by 2030; ban fracking.
- Homes: £6bn/yr for insulation; zero‑carbon new homes by 2021 (tightening to Passivhaus by 2025); zero‑carbon heat strategy.
- Nature: Nature Act with binding targets; plant 60m trees/yr; restore peatlands/wetlands; 50% UK waters as marine protected areas.
- Waste: Zero‑Waste & Resource Efficiency Act; ban non‑recyclable single‑use plastics within 3 years; deposit return schemes.
- Transport: EV-only new cars/vans by 2030; Clean Air Act and expanded ULEZ; rail electrification by 2035; freeze commuter fares; expand rail/light rail; restore bus routes; spend 10% of transport budget on walking/cycling.

Health and social care
- 1p on Income Tax to raise £7bn/yr for NHS and social care; £10bn capital upgrade plan.
- Integrate health and social care; tackle workforce shortages; bursaries for shortage nursing specialties; support unpaid carers (respite, benefits).
- Mental health: new waiting time standards; 24/7 crisis care and liaison teams in all hospitals; perinatal support; implement Wessely Review; free prescriptions for chronic MH conditions.

Housing, welfare and communities
- Build 300,000 homes/yr including 100,000 for social rent; zero‑carbon standards; Rent to Own; longer private tenancies and licensing; end rough sleeping in five years.
- Welfare: first Universal Credit payment in 5 days; scrap two‑child limit, benefit cap and bedroom tax; raise work allowances; legal right to food; align Local Housing Allowance with local rents.
- Crime: £1bn for community policing; £500m for youth services; public-health approach to violence; presumption against short prison sentences; Women’s Justice Board.

Rights, equality and migration
- Defend the Human Rights Act/ECHR; restore Legal Aid; rein in mass surveillance; ethical AI code.
- Scrap the hostile environment; 28‑day limit on immigration detention; right to work after 3 months for asylum seekers; resettle 10,000 unaccompanied child refugees over 10 years.
- Equality: make all hate crimes aggravated offences; reform Gender Recognition Act and recognise non‑binary; “X” passports; BSL Act; end period poverty.

Democracy and devolution
- Proportional representation (STV) for Commons and English councils; votes at 16; votes for long‑term EU residents and UK citizens abroad; reform House of Lords; written federal constitution; stronger devolution to nations/regions and local communities.

Foreign, defence and global action
- Pro‑EU, multilateralist foreign policy; maintain 0.7% aid; global climate leadership and Magnitsky sanctions.
- Suspend arms sales to Saudi Arabia; NATO 2% with cyber focus; maintain minimum nuclear deterrent (3 Dreadnought submarines, reduced readiness); recognise Palestine.

Animal welfare
- Enshrine animal sentience in law; tougher cruelty sentences; ban fur sales; end caged hens; reduce animal testing and improve farm welfare.
